description: Get public room rates for a hotel (the hotel's own public rate). Pass check_in and check_out dates (YYYY-MM-DD) to get nightly from-prices per room type. Without dates, returns the hotel's typical nightly from-price. No booking links; to price and book an exact room, use secure_room.

check_in.description: Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

check_out.description: Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to tomorrow)

hotel_id.description: Hotel UUID (the URL slug also works)

name: get_hotel_pricing

found.description: false when the hotel is unknown

roomTypes.description: Per-room-type from-prices when dates were given and live rates exist

fromNightly.description: Nightly from-price in whole dollars, hotel's own public rate

typicalNightlyFrom.description: Hotel-level typical nightly from-price in dollars

title: Get room rates
